comment: One activation at A over a fan-out/fan-in graph with a three-way topological tie (B, C, E). `repeat`: evaluate against input.lg this many times; every run's per-gate verdicts, master decision and log MUST equal `expected` and `log` (SPEC §7.5, rule 1). Then evaluate once against each `file` in `permutations`: the per-gate verdicts and master decision MUST equal `expected` (rule 2), and the log MUST equal that entry's `log`, which is the one the §7.4 declaration-order tie-break fixes for that file's gate order (rule 3). The verdicts in every log are the same; only the order of the tied gates B, C, E differs, and only where their declaration order differs.
